# dsh-update-checker

DSH (DeepSeek Harness) profile plugin: checks the npm registry for newer
`@deepseek-ai/dsh` releases

at startup and shows a quiet, GUI-styled notice in
the web sidebar when an update is available — cl

ick it to copy the update
command or open the npm page.
## Features

- Checks `registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai/dsh` at startup (fire-and-forget,
never blocks boot), cach

ed for 6 hours; re-polls every 30 min in the GUI
- Only appears when a newer version actually exists

— silent otherwise
- Sidebar footer item (expanded: icon + "vX.Y.Z 可用"; collapsed: icon only)
- Pop

over with: current/latest version, one-click **copy** of the update
command, npm link, and **忽略此版本**

(dismiss per version)
- Style tokens from the DSH GUI (`--dsw-*` design system) — auto-adapts to
li

ght/dark themes
- Zero disk footprint: host side is pure in-memory; the only persistent state
is a s

ingle localStorage key (dismissed version, a few bytes, overwritten —
never grows)
- Fail-safe: regi

stry unreachable or network errors → nothing is shown,
nothing crashes

## How it works
| Side | File | Role |
| Host | `lib/index.js` | Registers `GET /dsh-update-checker/check`; queries the npm registry on sta
rtup and on stale reads (6 h TTL); semver comparison (prerelease-aware); local version read from the

running `@deepseek-ai/dsh` package |
| Client | `lib/client.js` | Sidebar footer slot item; polls t
he endpoint every 30 min; popover with copy/npm/dismiss actions; dismissal persisted per version in
ery 30 min; popover with copy/npm/dismiss actions; dismissal persisted per version in localStorage |

## Uninstall

- Remove the `update-checker` entry from `cordis.patch.yml`
- Remove `~/.dsh/profiles/node_modules/d

sh-update-checker` and
`~/.dsh/profiles/packages/dsh-update-checker`
- Optional: delete the `dsh-upd

ate-checker.dismissed` key from browser
localStorage
